'''Dan Mailloux Death Star Mains Killer''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Dan Mailloux]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds104.htm Death Star Mains Killer], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228054713/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds104.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dan Mailloux]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
